buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses NOTES: · Tender is invited for supply of Lanoline and Sodium Petroleum Sulphonate (SPS) at Mazgaon Lube Plant on a schedule-wise basis. · Evaluation and ranking shall be carried out separately for each schedule on Net Delivered Rate (N DR) basis, followed by schedule-wise Online Reverse Auction, subject to applicable GeM rules and system functionality. · Contract validity shall be six months from the date of GeM Contract/HPCL PO/LOA, whichever is ea rlier. · Lead time shall be 30 days for the first supply and 15 days for subsequent supplies from the date of the respective call-up/release order. · Similar work shall mean successful supply of Lanoline or Wool Grease Natural for Schedule 1 and Sodium Petroleum Sulphonate for Schedule 2 during the prescribed seven-year period.

· Schedule-wise EMD shall be ₹3,30,000 for Lanoline and ₹1,66,000 for SPS. Bidders quoting for bot h schedules shall submit cumulative EMD of ₹4,96,000. · Only Class-I and Class-II Local Suppliers are eligible to participate; Non-Local Suppliers are not elig ible. · MSE and MII purchase preference shall apply as per tender conditions, with MSE purchase prefere nce taking precedence over MII purchase preference. · Order shall be distributed schedule-wise between two eligible bidders in the ratio of 70:30, subjec t to matching of L1 rates. Where only one bidder is eligible or no other eligible bidder accepts the L1 rate, 100% of the applicable quantity shall be allocated to L1, subject to applicable purchase-pr eference provisions. · Rates shall remain firm throughout the contract period, and no price escalation/de-escalation shall be applicable. · Security Deposit at 2% and Composite Performance Bank Guarantee at 5% shall apply as per tender conditions. · Material shall be supplied against call-ups/release orders issued by Mazgaon Lube Plant. Full sche dule quantity may or may not be consumed depending upon actual requirement, and HPCL does n ot guarantee any minimum purchase/business against the Purchase Order. · Detailed technical specifications for Lanoline and SPS are provided in the Buyer Added ATC. Bidde rs shall upload TDS, MSDS and a signed technical-compliance declaration with the techno-commer cial bid. · QC test results of HPCL Mazgaon Lube Plant QC Laboratory or any other HPCL-authorised laborato ry shall be final and binding. · Bidders shall upload all PQC documents, declarations, technical compliance statement, local-conte nt undertaking, Integrity Pact and other documents stipulated in the tender. · Unless otherwise specified, in case of conflict, HPCL General Terms and Conditions shall take prec edence over GeM General Terms and Conditions. · Bidders are advised to refer to the Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Document for complete tender d etails, technical specifications and requirements. . 3.
